svg.text: "The robot does not remember frames — it remembers compressed subtasks, and continuously reorganizes them under VLM guidance."
each Sᵢ = subtask-level latent slots | K slots per subtask | B_max = 512 tokens | grows → self-organizes
Execute first Δ=4 steps → Robot Control
Binary classifier: done=True triggers memory write
Perceiver compression: frames → K latent slots
Pairwise merge + importance scoring when B > B_max
Memory read at every action step
Cross-attention modulation in DiT layers (10 Hz)
~1 Hz: next subtask instruction + memory reorganize
VLM ~1 Hz | Action 10 Hz | Memory write: per subtask | Memory read: every step
Dual-thread: Perception (~1 Hz) ∥ Action Execution (~10 Hz)
VLM runs async; does not block action inference
